mentions.name: Hindi Speaking Tutor
mentions.description: A web app that gives kids a fun, always-available partner to practice conversational Hindi with, complementing the formal Hindi classes many children of Indian diaspora parents take.
mentions.problem: There are many language-learning apps, but almost none focused on improving conversational Hindi for kids, who often have no one to practice speaking with outside of family calls.
mentions.audience: Kids of the Indian diaspora who want a way to practice conversational Hindi outside of family calls, complementing their formal Hindi classes.
mentions.source_excerpt: Made this web app for my nephew, based in Singapore, after watching him struggle to find anyone to practice Hindi with outside of family calls (since most of his friends are Chinese). The idea is to have a 24x7 partner to speak with Hindi and make it fun. This can complement the formal Hindi classes that most kids of Indian diaspora parents take.
